description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterFilter, which provides a method to unregister a filter in the Smarty templating engine. It extends another class and implements logic to remove filters based on type and callback.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterFilter
classes.description: A class responsible for unregistering filters in Smarty, extending registration functionalities.

methods.name: unregisterFilter
methods.description: Unregisters a filter function of a specified type, removing it from Smarty's registered filters.
